title: Custom DIY Macropad
description: A custom macropad device that imitates keyboard keys and shortcut combinations.
intro: Built with a Raspberry Pi Pico, mechanical keyboard switches, diodes, and 3D printed parts, this macropad allows users to assign custom shortcuts to execute commands across various applications.

contentBlocks.heading: Why build a Macropad?
contentBlocks.text: Devices like this are widely used by streamers, editors, and digital artists. Having dedicated hardware for shortcuts speeds up workflow and removes the need to memorize complex keybindings.

contentBlocks.heading: Software & Tech Stack
contentBlocks.text: Powered by CircuitPython, it offers a much more convenient development setup than C++. Programming the board is as simple as saving a Python script to a USB drive.

conclusion: The software and 3D Models are developed by octosomething on printables.com.
